comments.author: 66325452@N02
comments.text:
Well thank you too!
My wife and I were married outside many years ago in a "wilderness" setting surrounded by just a few close friends. It was a choice we have never regretted. Through the years it has been one of the highlights of our lives to hike back to that spot in Grand Park on Mount Rainier and reflect on time past, and time still yet to come. Your lives being so connected to the out-of-doors in such an unassuming way is something I deeply respect, something I find inspiring too. Thanks for sharing it here on Flickr.
